"""Pre-registered train-subset component acceptance; no validation/test inference."""
import csv,hashlib,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import numpy as np
import torch
ROOT=Path('/home/lucky/devdir/rgzndl');sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))
from src.ect.prepare import PreparedDataset
from src.ect.baseline import stratified_rows
from src.ect.integrity import file_sha256
from src.ect.devices import seed_everything,resolve_device
from src.ect.preprocessing import standardize
from src.ect.paper_models import PaperResNeXt1D
from src.ect.paper_crops import training_crops,ten_crop_probabilities,crop_starts
from src.ect.evaluation import count_metrics,write_json,record_failure
FOLDER=ROOT/'results/paper_components/acceptance_v1'
CODE=['src/ect/paper_models.py','src/ect/paper_crops.py','src/ect/devices.py','src/ect/preprocessing.py','src/ect/prepare.py','src/ect/integrity.py','src/ect/baseline.py','src/ect/evaluation.py']
config=dict(model='PaperResNeXt1D',blocks_per_stage=3,classes=20,model_seed=0,sampling_seed=20261002,
    train_per_class=2,max_epochs=2000,batch_size=40,optimizer='Adam',learning_rate=4e-5,
    betas=[.9,.999],optimizer_eps=1e-8,weight_decay=0.,validation_crop_seed=10,
    inspect_every_epochs=100,training_memory_goal_accuracy=.95,stop_rule='first check >=0.95 or max_epochs',
    tf32=False,deterministic=True,classification_splits=['train_subset'],purpose='Component learning and device acceptance, not generalization or model comparison')
if sys.argv[1]=='register':
    FOLDER.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    with PreparedDataset(ROOT) as store:
        rows=stratified_rows(store.arrays['train'][1],2,20261002)
        records=[json.loads(x) for x in (ROOT/'manifests/grouped_v1/train.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
        registration=dict(schema_version=1,protocol='paper_component_acceptance_v1',status='frozen_before_training',
            registered_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),config=config,
            code_sha256={p:file_sha256(ROOT/p) for p in CODE},
            execution_script=Path(__file__).read_text(),execution_script_sha256=file_sha256(__file__),
            cache_metadata_sha256=file_sha256(store.folder/'metadata.json'),
            normalization_sha256=file_sha256(store.folder/'normalization.json'),
            manifest_sha256=store.metadata['manifest_sha256'],raw_input_sha256={k:v['sha256'] for k,v in store.metadata['inputs'].items()},
            formal_v1_registry_sha256=file_sha256(ROOT/'results/experiments/formal_v1/registry.json'),
            train_rows=rows.tolist(),wave_sha256=[records[i]['wave_sha256'] for i in rows],
            class_mapping_status='unverified',validation_classification_evaluated=False,test_classification_evaluated=False)
        write_json(FOLDER/'registration.json',registration)
    print('REGISTERED',len(rows),'train samples',file_sha256(FOLDER/'registration.json'),flush=True)
    sys.exit(0)
assert sys.argv[1]=='run'
registration=json.loads((FOLDER/'registration.json').read_text())
assert registration['config']==config
assert file_sha256(__file__)==registration['execution_script_sha256']
assert all(file_sha256(ROOT/p)==h for p,h in registration['code_sha256'].items())
assert not (FOLDER/'report.json').exists() and not (FOLDER/'failure.json').exists()
start=time.perf_counter();report=dict(schema_version=1,status='running',protocol='paper_component_acceptance_v1',
    created_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),registration_sha256=file_sha256(FOLDER/'registration.json'),
    config=config,history=[],validation_classification_evaluated=False,test_classification_evaluated=False)
try:
    seed_everything(0,1);device=resolve_device('cuda')
    with PreparedDataset(ROOT) as store:
        assert file_sha256(store.folder/'metadata.json')==registration['cache_metadata_sha256']
        rows=np.asarray(registration['train_rows']); x=store.arrays['train'][0][rows]; y=store.arrays['train'][1][rows]
        records=[json.loads(s) for s in (ROOT/'manifests/grouped_v1/train.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
        ids=[records[i]['wave_sha256'] for i in rows]
        assert ids==registration['wave_sha256'];assert np.array_equal(np.bincount(y),np.full(20,2))
        model=PaperResNeXt1D().to(device)
        assert sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters())==134654
        initial={k:p.detach().cpu().clone() for k,p in model.named_parameters()}
        optimizer=torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(),lr=4e-5,betas=(.9,.999),eps=1e-8,weight_decay=0)
        labels=torch.from_numpy(y.copy()).to(device)
        report['normalization']=store.stats
        report['environment']=dict(torch=str(torch.__version__),numpy=np.__version__,device=str(device),
            device_name=torch.cuda.get_device_name(device),deterministic=torch.are_deterministic_algorithms_enabled(),tf32=False)
        initial_probs=ten_crop_probabilities(model,x,ids,store.stats,seed=10,batch_size=128)
        report['initial_train_subset_metrics']=count_metrics(y,initial_probs.argmax(1),np.arange(20))
        goal=False
        for epoch in range(2000):
            model.train();crop=training_crops(x,ids,0,epoch)
            inputs=torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(standardize(crop,store.stats).transpose(0,2,1))).to(device)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True);logits=model(inputs)
            loss=torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(logits,labels)
            if not torch.isfinite(loss):raise ValueError('Nonfinite loss')
            loss.backward()
            if any(p.grad is not None and not torch.isfinite(p.grad).all() for p in model.parameters()):raise ValueError('Nonfinite gradient')
            optimizer.step()
            if (epoch+1)%100==0:
                probs=ten_crop_probabilities(model,x,ids,store.stats,seed=10,batch_size=128)
                metric=count_metrics(y,probs.argmax(1),np.arange(20))
                report['history'].append(dict(epochs_completed=epoch+1,last_batch_loss=float(loss.detach().cpu()),train_subset_metrics=metric))
                print('EPOCH',epoch+1,'loss',float(loss.detach().cpu()),'train memory 10-crop accuracy',metric['accuracy'],flush=True)
                if metric['accuracy']>=.95:goal=True;break
        state={k:v.detach().cpu().clone() for k,v in model.state_dict().items()}
        checkpoint=dict(schema_version=1,registration_sha256=report['registration_sha256'],model='PaperResNeXt1D',blocks_per_stage=3,num_classes=20,
            normalization=store.stats,epochs_completed=epoch+1,state_dict=state)
        torch.save(checkpoint,FOLDER/'model.pt')
        reloaded=torch.load(FOLDER/'model.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=True)
        cpu=PaperResNeXt1D().cpu().eval();cpu.load_state_dict(reloaded['state_dict'],strict=True)
        assert all(torch.equal(value,cpu.state_dict()[name]) for name,value in state.items())
        cpu_probs=ten_crop_probabilities(cpu,x,ids,store.stats,seed=10,batch_size=128)
        gpu_probs=ten_crop_probabilities(model,x,ids,store.stats,seed=10,batch_size=128)
        with (FOLDER/'train_subset_predictions.csv').open('w',newline='') as h:
            writer=csv.writer(h,lineterminator='\n');writer.writerow(['train_row','wave_sha256','class_index','gpu_prediction','cpu_prediction'])
            writer.writerows((int(row),ids[i],int(y[i]),int(gpu_probs[i].argmax()),int(cpu_probs[i].argmax())) for i,row in enumerate(rows))
        report.update(status='complete',epochs_completed=epoch+1,overfit_goal_reached=goal,parameter_count=134654,
            train_subset_metrics=count_metrics(y,gpu_probs.argmax(1),np.arange(20)),cpu_train_subset_metrics=count_metrics(y,cpu_probs.argmax(1),np.arange(20)),
            cpu_checkpoint_tensors=True,cpu_state_exactly_matches_saved_checkpoint=True,
            gpu_cpu_max_probability_abs_error=float(np.max(np.abs(gpu_probs-cpu_probs))),
            gpu_cpu_class_difference_count=int((gpu_probs.argmax(1)!=cpu_probs.argmax(1)).sum()),
            changed_parameter_tensors=sum(not torch.equal(initial[k],p.detach().cpu()) for k,p in model.named_parameters()),
            files_sha256={name:file_sha256(FOLDER/name) for name in ['model.pt','train_subset_predictions.csv']},
            original_code_unchanged=all(file_sha256(ROOT/p)==h for p,h in registration['code_sha256'].items()),
            elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter()-start)
        assert report['original_code_unchanged']
        write_json(FOLDER/'report.json',report)
    print('COMPLETE','goal',goal,'epochs',epoch+1,'acc',report['train_subset_metrics']['accuracy'],'CPU class diff',report['gpu_cpu_class_difference_count'],flush=True)
except BaseException as error:
    record_failure(FOLDER,report,error,start);raise
